thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime memory pressure -> GPU paging surge detected on gpu-pool-2. Severity P1. Service: inference-runtime-hosted. Detected 2024-09-03T02:34:39Z. Pager routed to leila (oncall).

leila (oncall): acknowledged. joining. what's the visible customer impact?

marc: I'm seeing elevated 502/504s for a few production customers: gamma-labs (~9% errors) and hydra-platform (~4%). Traces show stalled streaming responses around first token emit.

ivan: grabbing logs and alloc maps. Quick paste from gpu-2 kernel/logs:
```
[02:35:07] runtime: alloc request 12.8GB contiguous failed, available total 14.3GB but max contiguous 420MB
[02:35:08] gpu-pager: start paging, reclaimable chunks ~200MB
[02:35:09] kernel: NPU_OOM: pid=9832 runtime alloc_contig size=12884901888
[02:35:09] runtime: fatal: cannot reserve kv slab: out of memory
```

leila (oncall): building timeline in-thread:
- 02:33:50Z small bump in p95 latency
- 02:34:10Z p99 for /v1/chat/generate spikes, streaming timeouts follow
- 02:34:39Z pager events + NPU_OOMs on multiple nodes in gpu-pool-2
- 02:34:45Z incident thread auto-opened

marc: alloc map snapshots show extreme fragmentation: largest free-run ~420MB, many small islands. KV cache shows many pinned hot entries (session durations long, prefix lengths > 2500 tokens). Prefetch configured: kv.prefetch.window=12.

ivan: immediate mitigations proposed/applied: 1) reduce route batch_size from 12 -> 6 on pool-2 2) disable kv.prefetch on the pool (`kv.prefetch.enable=false`) 3) enable a per-route long-prefix throttle (route.long_prefix:max_concurrent=3) 4) schedule a canary compaction on gpu-2-pod-3 with a 5m drain window.

marc: customer impact note: gamma-labs error rate dropped from 9% -> 5% after batch change; hydra-platform traces improved but still seeing mid-stream aborts on a small shard. Support notified; support ticket GAMMA-402 opened.

ivan: diagnostic command snippets for RCA (pinned here):
```
# capture alloc map and kv stats
kubectl exec -n inference runtime-gpu-2-pod-3 -- curl -sS http://localhost:9000/debug/alloc_map > /tmp/alloc_map_gpu2_p3.txt
rds-cli kv-stats --pool gpu-pool-2 --out /tmp/kv_stats_pool2.json
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv -i 2
```

leila (oncall): hypothesis tracker:
- H1 (primary): KV cache fragmentation due to long prefixes + aggressive prefetching -> contiguous allocation failures. Evidence: alloc_map, kv stats, prefetch window high. Actions: prefetch off, compaction sweep, monitor.
- H2: Request-level packing/batching placed multiple long-prefix requests together creating ephemeral mega-allocs > largest free-run. Evidence: batch traces correlate with spike. Actions: reduce batch_size and add packing heuristics to avoid multi-long-prefix in same batch.
- H3: Driver-level or kernel allocator bug surfaced under this workload. Evidence: inconsistent fragmentation across identical nodes. Actions: collect driver traces, escalate if reproducible.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: labels added [oom, gpu-paging, kv-fragmentation, canary] and ticket RED-10421 created for follow-ups.

ivan: canary compaction started at 02:48Z on gpu-2-pod-3. Using incremental zone compaction tool (kv-zone-compact --fast). Will monitor for latency blips. Logs to s3: s3://redwood-ops/insights/2812345679/canary/

(02:57:10Z) ivan: canary compaction finished. Largest contiguous free-run increased from 430MB -> 1.6GB on canary. No new OOMs on that pod. Minor CPU spike (+12%) during compaction but within safe limits.

marc: metrics post-canary: p99 latency on canary shard normalized, gamma-labs error rate down to 2% for that shard. Planning rolling compaction with 5m drains across pool-2.

leila (oncall): rolling compaction plan: sequential apply to remaining pods with 5-minute drain windows; keep batch_size reduced and prefetch disabled until entire pool validated. If any compaction causes regressions, abort roll and revert to emergency config.

ivan: rolling compaction in progress. Artifacts: `s3://redwood-ops/insights/2812345679/` contains alloc_maps, kernel logs, kv stats, and batch traces.

(03:26:44Z) marc: rolling compaction complete. Post-compact median largest free-run ~1.5GB across pool-2. OOMs dropped to 0/min, p99 returned to baseline. Customers notified.

leila (oncall): post-mitigation checklist before handoff:
- keep long-prefix throttle for 6 hours
- keep kv.prefetch disabled on pool-2 until we ship safer prefetch heuristics
- collect per-request prefix histograms and batch composition for 30m pre/ post incident (for RCA)
- schedule a follow-up to implement auto-incremental compaction during low-traffic windows

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked mitigated. RCA draft created at `docs/incidents/2812345679-oom-kv-defrag-rca.md`. Follow-up tickets: RED-10421, RED-10422.

(03:44:39Z) leila (oncall): handing off monitoring to night oncall ivan. Please keep stricter alerts for largest_contiguous_free_run < 1GB and OOM > 0/min.

ivan: acking takeover. I'll tighten alerts and follow up on RED-10421 tomorrow.

(03:52:59Z) incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigation validated). Artifacts archive: s3://redwood-ops/insights/2812345679/
